core_obligations: Short exact sequences: for an element f outside the prime, the spectral sequence of the two supports degenerates to give short exact sequences relating the local cohomology of the ideal enlarged by f, the local cohomology of the principal open applied to the local cohomology of the ideal, and the local cohomology of the ideal, at every degree (proof lines 472-479)
Assertion (1): the displayed sequences identify the image of the colimit map with the elements mapping to zero in the localisation of the local cohomology of the ideal at the prime (proof line 480)
Assertion (2): the injectivity statement follows from the same identification together with the vanishing statement for the multiplicative set of the elements outside the prime (proof lines 480-481)
Assertion (3): the isomorphism statement is the conjunction of the previous two and is recorded as a formal consequence (proof line 482)
proof_roadmap: 对 f ∉ p，由 dualizing 章的谱序列退化得到短正合列 0 → H^1_{V(f)}(H^{i-1}_{V(I)}(M)) → H^i_{V((I,f))}(M) → H^0_{V(f)}(H^i_{V(I)}(M)) → 0。
由此 (1)：像等于在 H^i_{V(I)}(M)_p 中为零的元素；(2) 由该描述加上「S = A∖p 时 colim 的 H^1 为 0」（lemma-multiplicative）得到；(3) 为 (1)(2) 的形式推论。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement describes the image of the canonical map from the filtered colimit of the local cohomologies of the ideals generated by the ideal together with an element outside a prime, in three parts: the image is the kernel of the localisation at the prime, the map is injective when one degree lower vanishes after localisation, and it is an isomorphism when both degrees vanish (author lemma at source lines 451-470, label lemma-elements-come-from-bigger). The proof (source lines 472-483) gets a short exact sequence at each degree from the degeneration of the local cohomology spectral sequence of the chapter on dualizing complexes, reads off the image, and completes the injectivity statement with the vanishing of the colimit for the multiplicative set of elements outside the prime, whose statement is reproduced as a context span (proof lines 473-481). The degeneration and the identification of the image are the content. H2.
